subject: Maintaining factor levels - Plot within Plot

messages.author: ddc91303cb21ac62
messages.subject: Maintaining factor levels - Plot within Plot
parts:
Hello ggplot2ers,

I wanted to place a plot within another plot but am having trouble
getting the legends just how I want them. The subplot use the complete
dataset whereas the main plot uses a subset of the data. As a result a
level from the colour aesthetic is drop and the main legend now only
show one factor level. I know ggplot2 is doing exactly what I am
telling it to do but I was wondering if there was a way that I could
use the factor levels in the subplot to make the legend for the bigger
plot? The example below should illustrate my problem:

library(ggplot2)
library(grid)

## Data generation
wdf <- rbind(
data.frame(Date=seq(as.Date("2000/10/1"),as.Date("2003/9/30"),"4 weeks"),
fac = "Group1", var=1:40),
data.frame(Date=seq(as.Date("2001/10/1"),as.Date("2003/9/30"),"4 weeks"),
fac = "Group2", var=runif(27,3,13))
)

## I want the factor levels present in this plot to translate into
legend in the other plot
lil<-ggplot(wdf, aes(x=Date, y=var, colour=fac))+
opts(legend.position = "none") + ## But this legend within the plot
is a little ugly
geom_line()

## This plot, because it is subsetted only produces one group
big<-ggplot(wdf[wdf$Date<as.Date("2001/10/1"),], aes(x=Date, y=var,
colour=fac))+
#opts(legend.position = "none") +
geom_line()

## To produce the plot within plot
vp <- viewport(width = 0.4, height = 0.4,
x = 0.8, y = unit(4, "lines"),
just = c("right","bottom"))

full <- function() {
print(big)
print(lil, vp = vp)
}

full()


Thanks in advance!

Sam

messages.subject: Re: Maintaining factor levels - Plot within Plot
parts:
Hi

Here is the workaround:

lil<-ggplot(wdf, aes(x=Date, y=var, colour=fac)) +
## This plot, because it is subsetted only produces one group

wdf2 <- wdf[wdf$Date<as.Date("2001/10/1"),]
wdf2 <- rbind(wdf2, data.frame(Date = NA, fac = "Group2", var = NA))
big <- ggplot(wdf2, aes(x=Date, y=var, colour=fac)) +
geom_line() +
scale_colour_manual(values = c("red", "blue"), breaks = c("Group1",
"Group2"), guide = "legend")

## To produce the plot within plot
vp <- viewport(width = 0.4, height = 0.4,
x = 0.8, y = unit(4, "lines"),
just = c("right","bottom"))

full <- function() {
print(big)
print(lil, vp = vp)
}

full()
